title: refactor(spec)!: rename the Studio helper defineForm to defineMetadataForm and its modules to *.metadata-form.ts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-alice"} -->
_Requested by **Alice** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH?thread=cmsg_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePHFWD6iz7PPMS45VYs9bUvQp)_

Part of #37086 — PR A of the card's fixed 3,000-line cut: item 3's rename and suffix move alone, no behaviour. PR B (everything else, the `form` type with its factory `defineForm`) is stacked on this branch and closes the card.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #37105

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：Studio 内部用来定义"元数据编辑表单"的工具函数改了名字，相关的 18 个文件也换了后缀，界面和行为都不变。
- 属于"表单拆成独立 form 元数据类型"这一组工作，先把原来的名字和文件后缀让给新的表单类型。
- 出错时只会在编译阶段报错（找不到旧名字），不会影响运行中的数据；可以直接撤回这个改动。
- 无。

## What changes

- `defineForm` (the Studio schema-bound metadata-form helper, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`) is renamed `defineMetadataForm`, with the same argument and result; `packages/spec/src/index.ts` and the `@objectstack/spec/ui` barrel export the new name, and `packages/spec/tsup.config.ts`'s pure-constructor set names it. `defineForm` is absent between this PR and PR B, never dual-meaning (ADR-0159 question 1, ruled A, ruling record 7131569242).
- The 18 Studio modules move from `*.form.ts` to `*.metadata-form.ts` (the card counted 17 at `689e5695b98`; 18 at this head, `email-template` being the newer one), plus their one dedicated test (`ai-context.metadata-form.test.ts`). Import specifiers swept by both spellings: 32 files under `packages/spec/src` (the seven domain barrels, `system/metadata-form-registry.ts`, the tests, and `kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts`'s 15 `../DIR/NAME.form` imports).
- `scripts/i18n-bundle-surface.mjs`: `METADATA_FORM_MODULE_SUFFIX` becomes `.metadata-form.ts`, its module note re-worded. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` re-spells its suffix cases (the live-walk assertion included) and gains one case: a `form` item source (`examples/app-crm/src/forms/lead.form.ts`) is not a metadata-form module. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` kind text, `scripts/pm/landing-k.mjs` fixture path, `scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs` comments. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is not edited (it spells no suffix).
- Text that teaches the suffix is re-worded to the new one: `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (the `visibility-root-mislayered` explanation), the `data` arm of the field-rule message in `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, the docblock of `validate-visibility-predicates.ts` with its two `toContain` pins and the `MOVED` token pin, and the row of `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`. The test's file-name detector reads both spellings (`/[.-](form|view|page)\.ts/`).
- Comments and live path citations re-pointed under `packages/lint/src`, `packages/cli/src`, `packages/cli/test`, `packages/platform-objects/src`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src`, `packages/spec/src`, `packages/spec/liveness/`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`, and two live citations in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`.
- Generated: `packages/spec/api-surface*`, `packages/spec/export-origins/` (7 files), `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`, regenerated by `check:generated --fix`.
- ADR-0087: registered semantic entry `define-form-studio-helper-renamed-define-metadata-form` (the `runtime-export-retired` category is closed: the helper is declared in a `*.zod.ts`, a metadata surface by the gate's reading).

### Outside-use reading (question 1), recorded before the rename's first commit

- Public repositories of the org: no import or call of `defineForm` outside this repository (seat record 7177011389 on #37086, each repository's head listed there; objectui's one hit is a comment).
- `objectstack-ai/cloud` at `03769766a92`: 0 hits (repo:cloud seat record 7177053511).

### Count at this head (`80da0864` base)

`git grep -lw defineForm` named 61 files at the base. After this PR the word survives only in released or historical text, which is not rewritten: 8 `CHANGELOG.md`, `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`, `docs/audits/2026-06-handwritten-docs-accuracy-followups.md`, ADR-0159 itself, the new migration entry and changeset (which name the old spelling as the FROM side), and the historical sentence added to `defineMetadataForm`'s docblock.

## Tests

<details><summary>Local runs at this head</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 3 of 14 stale before `--fix` (api-surface, export-origins, docs), 14 of 14 green after.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 894 passed, 1 skipped (895); Tests 28417 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run`: Test Files 235 passed (235); Tests 9629 passed.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (the self-test this PR edits): 2314 cases pass, fast tier.
- Changeset and ledger gates: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` 0, `check-changeset-no-major` 0, `check-empty-changeset` 0; `check:commit-card-trailers` 0, `check:nul-bytes` 0, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority` 0, `check-skills-token-ratchet` 0 (and `--self-test` 0), `check:i18n-stale-fill` 0, `check:adr-anchors` 0, `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` 0, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors` 0, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` 0, `landing-k --self-test` 0, `check:i18n-walk-parity` 0. `check:i18n-coverage` NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, example build closure absent): cited from CI.
- `pnpm check:i18n`: OK, 10 packages in sync; `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` changed no bundle (`git status` clean after it).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Not edited, named for the seat: `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` lines 264 and 318 spell `*.form.ts` and `defineForm` (a governed path); `ui/docs/adr/0056-permission-editing-studio.md` line 349 names `security/permission.form.ts` (an ADR); `docs/adr/0159` is the record itself. Two pending changesets (`35926-field-inline-edit-boolean-retired.md`, `36425-retire-internal-forms.md`) and two released migration entries (`18.field-max-length-…`, `18.field-min-length-…`) and `registry.ts.template` name the old spelling as history; not rewritten.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is red at this head on `areas/automation.json` (`FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx#FlowItemMoreMenu`), a file this PR does not touch: red at the base `80da0864` too. The scoped run `--changed-from origin/main` is green.
- The protocol line is `none` here although the card's claim reads `narrowed`: the card's narrowing (item 5's refusal) ships in PR B, which carries `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`. This PR changes no metadata an author writes.

## Verification

Two minutes: `git grep -nw defineForm -- packages ui scripts` returns only the docblock's history sentence and the migration entry; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/metadata-form-registry` (or any metadata-form test) is green.
